titlePlain: A Role That Exposed a Whole
subtitle: Lesson 31 · Capstone: Securing a Multi-Cloud Environment (illustrative case study)

caption: Meant for one resource group's deployments -- but AssignableScopes lists the whole subscription.

steps.label: Too-broad actions
steps.sub: virtualMachineScaleSets/* reaches every scale set, not just restart/scale

steps.label: Result
steps.sub: CI/CD identity could reach data-platform resources it never used

code:
Defender for Cloud recommendation:
"A service principal has write access to an
unusually large number of resource groups."

$ az role assignment list \
    --assignee <meridian-cicd-sp-object-id> --all

-> one assignment, subscription scope, unrecognized custom role
caption: Nobody found this in a planned review -- a routine posture recommendation led to it sideways.

code:
1. Re-scope the assignment to rg-meridian-prod-app
2. Replace the wildcard with restart/action + scaleSets/write
3. Prefer built-in roles: Virtual Machine Contributor
   + Monitoring Reader, scoped to one resource group
4. Add a standing review for any subscription-scope
   custom role assignment
caption: Fewer custom roles, correctly scoped, means fewer chances for this exact mistake to recur.
